recipes.name: Tomato Zucchini Squash Skillet
ingredients_raw: 1 tablespoon salted butter, or more as needed
1 Vidalia onion, cut into bite-size pieces
1 yellow squash, cut into bite-size pieces
4 roma (plum) tomatoes, cut into bite-size pieces
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir onion in melted butter until translucent, 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in zucchini and yellow squash; cook until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Mix in tomatoes and cook until they start to break down, about 5 more minutes. Season with kosher salt and black pepper.

raw_recipe.headline: Tomato Zucchini Squash Skillet
raw_recipe.description: Fresh tomatoes, zucchini, yellow squash, and sweet onion are cooked in butter for a perfect summer side for grilled meats or for a nice warm winter warm-up when you are wishing for a summer side.

review.reviewBody: This is delicious! I cheated a little, and used a can of fire roasted tomatoes with garlic, and added basil, thyme, and oregano. This would be great as a main dish by adding chicken breast and pasta.

Add squash with onion and garlic. Added yellow and orange peppers near the end. Added another reviewers CUMIN. Omg yum
I will make the squash pieces smaller than the other veggie pieces next time.
Made this with cut up chicken and it was delicious!! It was a wonderful main meal. I cooked the chicken first then added the onion, etc. I love tweaking when I can.

I didn't have yellow squash, left it out. I used a mixture of olive oil and butter. I added a large clove of minced shallot to the vidilia onion. I added a dusting of panko and parm cheese. even with mostly hot house grown maters and zukes it was very good. served with dill pickle meatloaf and mac and cheese. when our garden comes in, I'll be sure to trot this easy recipe out again.

This was delicious and easy to make! I also added some other veggies that I had just picked in the garden (snow peas and okra) and as someone had suggested, seasoned it also with basil, thyme and oregano. Loved it. I will be making this again.

Pretty Good... I used yellow squash & cherry tomatoes because that's what I had available. This dish was super easy to make and surprisingly delicious. I did add garlic while the onions were cooking and I added Italian seasoning on everything. Very good and will make again!

Really liked this simple side dish for squash. I only had zucchini so used that and added a bit of EVOO with the butter. Put the lid on during the sautéing to help soften the squash before adding the tomato and addition of fresh garlic.

It was easy and tasty. I didn't have a Vidalia onion so I used green onions. And I didn't have fresh tomatoes. So I used a drained out can of diced tomatoes. So thankfully it turned out good. And would be better with fresh food the recipe calls for. I will make this again!?

Got a mess of tomatoes , zucchini and squash. Found this easy, simple old fashion recipe that tastes like my family's at the reunion's growing up. Thank you very much. I also add a teaspoon of sugar to most of my vegetables. Something my 107 year old auntie taught me years ago. 😉

instead of salt and pepper ; used Weber Roasted Garlic & Herb seasoning. Next time do 3 Roma Tomatoes instead 4 ( wife's suggestion). A very good side with saffron yellow rice and a couple of beer battered cod fish fillets.

I loved this. Very easy. I used zucchini squash. I also seasoned it as it was cooking. 
Then.... I spooned some into a tortilla and topped with some salsa.
Yum!! and filling. 
I also added a little roasted chicken but it can easily be left out for a veggie meal.
I added mozzarella cheese chunks on top and put it I the oven to keep warm. Yum!
I added a lot of garlic to it. Its fantastic!!!
Cooked with what was available, 2 squash 1 zucchini 1 tomato 1 Vidalia onion
I added a little cumin, as recommended by another reviewer, and some garlic salt. It tastes wonderful!
Loved it!! Made it with a baked porkchop recipe from this site as well. We will be making this easy and delicious side again!
Best and healthy side dish
This was really good! I loved it and even my picky son who has voiced his dislike for zucchini, tomatoes, and onions on several occasions loved it as well.
It's quick, easy and versatile. You can change it up in so many ways. I added garlic. You could throw in some parmesan, chopped parsley or oregano. But just plain is delicious

This recipe is wonderful. My Italian grandmother used to melt Cheddar or American cheese on a slice of bread and spoon this on top, serving it open face. We prefer American or Cheddar cheese but you can use just about any cheese. This recipe is perfect and is just how I remember it. Thank you.
